text: In the raashayath (beginning) Alahayam baraa (created) the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the aratz (Earth/land) was thahaw (formless) and empty. Chashak (darkness) panayam (face) on the surface of the thahawam (depths). Alahayam rawach (spirit / wind) was hovering il (over) the surface of the mayam (Waters).
Alahayam amar (said), “Let there be awar (light),” and there was awar (light).
Alahayam raah (see) the awar (light), and saw that it was tawab (good / proper function). Alahayam divided the awar (light) from the chashak (darkness).
Alahayam qaraa (called) the awar (light) “yawam (day)”, and the chashak (darkness) he qaraa (called) “layal (night)”. There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), achad (one) yawam (day).
Alahayam amar (said), “Let there be an raqayai (Firmament) in the thawak (midst) of the mayam (Waters), and let it badal (separated) the mayam (Waters) from the mayam (Waters).”

Alahayam ishah (make) the raqayai (Firmament), and badal (separated) the mayam (Waters) which were thachath (under) the raqayai (Firmament) from the mayam (Waters) which were il (over) the raqayai (Firmament); and it was kan (for sure).
Alahayam qaraa (called) the raqayai (Firmament) “shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens)”. There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a shanay (second) yawam (day).

Alahayam amar (said), “Let the mayam (Waters) under the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) be qawah (gather/wait) together to achad (one) maqawam (place), and let the yabashah (dry land) land raah (see);” and it was so.

Alahayam qaraa (called) the yabashah (dry land) aratz (Earth/land) “earth”, and the maqawah (gathering / collection) together of the mayam (Waters) he qaraa (called) “yamayam (seas)”. Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (good / proper function).

Alahayam amar (said), “Let the aratz (Earth/land) yield dashaa (grass), ishab (herbs) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed), and paray (fruit) itz (trees) ishah (make) paray (fruit) after their mayan (species), with its zarai (seed) in it, on the aratz (Earth/land);” and it was so.

The aratz (Earth/land) yielded dashaa (grass), ishab (herbs) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed) after their mayan (species), and itz (trees) ishah (make) paray (fruit), with its zarai (seed) in it, after their mayan (species); and Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (good / proper function).
There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a shalayashay (third) yawam (day).

Alahayam amar (said), “Let there be maawarath (lights) in the raqayai (Firmament) of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) to badal (separated) the yawam (day) from the layal (night); and let them be for awathath (signs), and for mawaidayam (seasons), and for yawamayam (days) and shanahayam (years);
And let them be for maawarath (lights) in the raqayai (Firmament) of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) to give awar (light) on the aratz (Earth/land);” and it was so.

Alahayam ishah (make) the shanayam (two) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) maawarath (lights): the greater maawar (Luminary / Light) to mamashalah (rule / govern) the yawam (day), and the qatan (small / young / least) maawar (Luminary / Light) to mamashalah (rule / govern) the layal (night). He also made the kawakabayam (stars).
Alahayam nathan (give) them in the raqayai (Firmament) of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) to give awar (light) to the aratz (Earth/land),

And to mashal (rule/have dominion) over the yawam (day) and over the layal (night), and to badal (separated) the awar (light) from the chashak (darkness). Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (good / proper function).
There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a rabayaiy (fourth) yawam (day).

Alahayam amar (said), “Let the mayam (Waters) swarm with sharatz (swarm as many) of chay (life) sharatz (swarms/swarming thing), and let iwap (flying) iwap (flying) il (over) the aratz (Earth/land) in the panayam (face) raqayai (Firmament) of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).”

Alahayam baraa (created) the large thanayan (sea) creatures, and every chay (life) napash (soul) that ramash (moves), with which the mayam (Waters) sharatz (swarm as many), after their mayan (species), and every kanap (winged) iwap (flying) after its mayan (species). Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (good / proper function).

Alahayam barak (blessed) them, amar (said), “Be parah (bear fruit / increase), and rabah (multiply), and malaa (fill) the mayam (Waters) in the yamayam (seas), and let iwap (flying) rabah (multiply) on the aratz (Earth/land).”
There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a chamayashay (fifth) yawam (day).

Alahayam amar (said), “Let the aratz (Earth/land) produce chay (life) napash (soul) after their mayan (species), livestock, ramash (creeping) things, and animals of the aratz (Earth/land) after their mayan (species);” and it was so.

Alahayam ishah (make) the animals of the aratz (Earth/land) after their mayan (species), and the livestock after their mayan (species), and everything that creeps on the adamah (ground) after its mayan (species). Alahayam raah (see) that it was tawab (good / proper function).

Alahayam amar (said), “Let us ishah (make) adam (man) in our tzalam (likeness), after our damawath (likeness): and let them radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) dominion over the dagah (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), and over the iwap (flying) of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and over the livestock, and over all the aratz (Earth/land), and over every ramash (creeping) thing that ramash (creeps) on the aratz (Earth/land).”
Alahayam baraa (created) adam (man) in his own tzalam (likeness). In Alahayam tzalam (likeness) he baraa (created) him; zakar (male) and naqabah (female) he baraa (created) them.

Alahayam barak (blessed) them. Alahayam amar (said) to them, “Be parah (bear fruit / increase), rabah (multiply), malaa (fill) the aratz (Earth/land), and kabash (subdue / force) it. Radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) dominion over the dagah (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), over the iwap (flying) of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and over every chay (life) thing that ramash (moves) on the aratz (Earth/land).”

Alahayam amar (said), “hanah (Behold), I nathan (give) given you every ishab (herb) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed), which is on the surface of all the aratz (Earth/land), and every itz (tree), which bears paray (fruit) zarai (yielding) zarai (seed). It will be your akalah (food).

To every animal of the aratz (Earth/land), and to every iwap (flying) of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and to everything that ramash (creeps) on the aratz (Earth/land), in which there is chay (life), I have given every yaraq (green) ishab (herb) for akalah (food);” and it was so.

Alahayam raah (see) everything that he ishah (make) made, and, behold, it was very tawab (good / proper function). There was irab (evening) and there was baqar (morning), a shashay (sixth) yawam (day).
The shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and the aratz (Earth/land) were kalah (complete / finish), and all their vast array.

On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) Alahayam kalah (complete / finish) his malaakah (work) which he ishah (make) made; and he shabath (Shabath / Rest) on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) from all his malaakah (work) which he ishah (make) made.

Alahayam barak (blessed) the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), and made it qadash (Holy / Set Apart), kay (surely) he shabath (Shabath / Rest) in it from all his malaakah (work) which he had baraa (created) and ishah (make).

This is the history of the thawaladahawath (generations) of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and of the aratz (Earth/land) when they were baraa (created), in the yawam (day) that Yahawah Alahayam ishah (make) the aratz (Earth/land) and the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

No shayach (bush / shrub) of the shadah (field / open country) was yet in the aratz (Earth/land), and no ishab (herb) of the shadah (field / open country) had yet tzamach (sprout / spring forth) up; for Yahawah Alahayam had not caused it to matar (rain) on the aratz (Earth/land). There was not a adam (man) to ibad (servant) the adamah (ground),
But a ad (mist) ilah (go up / offer) up from the aratz (Earth/land), and shaqah (water / give drink) the whole surface of the adamah (ground).

Yahawah Alahayam yatzar (form / fashion / shape) adam (man) from the ipar (dust) of the adamah (ground), and napach (breathe / blow) into his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) the nashamah (breathing thing) of chay (life); and adam (man) became a chay (life) napash (soul).
Yahawah Alahayam natai (plant) a gan (garden) eastward, in Idan (Eden), and there he shawam (place / establish / appoint) the adam (man) whom he had yatzar (form / fashion / shape).

Out of the adamah (ground) Yahawah Alahayam tzamach (sprout / spring forth) every itz (tree) to tzamach (sprout / spring forth) that is chamad (pleasant / desirable) to the maraah (sight), and tawab (good / proper function) for maakal (food); the itz (tree) of chay (life) also in the thawak (midst) of the gan (garden), and the itz (tree) of the daith (knowledge) of tawab (good / proper function) and rai (evil / dysfunction).

A nahar (river) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Idan (Eden) to shaqah (water / give drink) the gan (garden); and from there it was parad (divide / separate), and became arabai (four) raashayam (heads).

The sham (name) of the achad (one) is Payashawan (Pishon): hawaa (which/who/that is) is the sabab (surround / encompass) which flows through the whole aratz (Earth/land) of Chawayalah (Havilah), ashar (who/that) there is zahab (gold);
And the zahab (gold) of that aratz (Earth/land) is tawab (good / proper function). There is aromatic resin and the shaham (Onyx) aban (stone).
The sham (name) of the shanay (second) nahar (river) is Gayachawan (Gihon): the same sabab (surround / encompass) that flows through the whole aratz (Earth/land) of Kawash (Cush).

The sham (name) of the shalayashay (third) nahar (river) is Chadaqal (Hiddekel): this is the halak (move) which flows in front of Ashawar (Assyria). The rabayaiy (fourth) nahar (river) is the Parath (Euphrates).
Yahawah Alahayam laqach (take / seize) the adam (man), and yanach (settled) him into the gan (garden) of Idan (Eden) to ibad (servant) it and to shamar (keep/guard) it.
Yahawah Alahayam tzawah (command) the adam (man), amar (said), “Of every itz (tree) of the gan (garden) you may akal (eat) akal (eat);

But of the itz (tree) of the daith (knowledge) of tawab (good / proper function) and rai (evil / dysfunction), you shall not akal (eat) of it; for in the yawam (day) that you akal (eat) of it you will mawath (death) mawath (death).”
Yahawah Alahayam amar (said), “It is not tawab (good / proper function) that the adam (man) should be alone; I will ishah (make) him a izar (helper) suitable for him.”

Out of the adamah (ground) Yahawah Alahayam yatzar (form / fashion / shape) every animal of the shadah (field / open country), and every iwap (flying) of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and bawaa (come) them to the adam (man) to raah (see) what he would qaraa (called) them. Whatever the adam (man) qaraa (called) every chay (life) napash (soul), that was its sham (name).

The adam (man) gave shamawath (names) to all livestock, and to the iwap (flying) of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and to every animal of the shadah (field / open country); but for adam (man) there was not matzaa (find / discover) a izar (helper) suitable for him.

Yahawah Alahayam napal (fall / be cast down) a tharadamah (deep sleep) sleep to napal (fall / be cast down) on the Adam (man), and he yashan (sleep); and he laqach (take / seize) achad (one) of his tzalai (side), and sagar (seal / close) up the bashar (flesh) in its place.
He banah (build) the tzalai (side), which Yahawah Alahayam had laqach (take / seize) from the adam (man), into a ayashah (woman), and bawaa (come) her to the adam (man).

The adam (man) amar (said), “zaath (this) is paim (time) itzam (selfsame / essence) of my itzam (selfsame / essence), and bashar (flesh) of my bashar (flesh). She will be qaraa (called) ‘ayashah (woman),’ because she was laqach (take / seize) out of ayash (man).”
Therefore a ayash (man) will izab (leave / forsake) his ab (father) and his am (mother), and will join with his ayashah (woman), and they will be achad (one) bashar (flesh).
They were shanayam (two) irawam (naked), the adam (man) and his ayashah (woman), and were not bawash (ashamed / disappointed).

WaHaNachash (And now the serpent) was more subtle than any animal HaShadah (of the field) which Yahawah Alahayam YaIshah (had made). WaYaAmar (And he said) HaAyashah (to the woman), “Has Alahayam YaAmar (really said), ‘ThaAkalaw (You shall not eat) Itz (of any tree) HaGan (of the garden)’?”
HaAyashah (The woman) WaThaAmar (and said) HaNachash (to the serpent), “MaParay (Of the fruit) Itz (of the trees) HaGan (of the garden) NaAkal (we may eat),

WaMaParay (and of the fruit) HaItz (of the tree) BaThawak (which is in the middle) HaGan (of the garden), Alahayam YaAmar (has said), ‘ThaAkalaw (You shall not eat) of it, ThaNagaiw (neither shall you touch) it, lest ThaMawathawan (you die - emphatic).’”
HaNachash (The serpent) WaYaAmar (and said) HaAyashah (to the woman), “Mawath (You won't surely) ThaMawathawan (die - emphatic),

For Alahayam Yadai (knows) BaYawam (that in the day) Akalakam (you eat) it, Iyanayakam (your eyes) WaNaPaqachaw (and will be opened), and you will be like Alahayam, Yadaiy (knowing) Tawab (good) WaRai (and evil).”

HaAyashah (When the woman) WaThaRaah (and saw) HaItz (that the tree) Tawab (was good) LaMaakal (for food), and that it was a delight LaIyanayam (to the eyes), HaItz (and that the tree) WaNaChamad (and was to be desired) LaHaShakayal (to make one wise), WaThaLaqach (and she took) of its fruit, WaThaAkal (and ate); WaThaNathan (and she gave) some LaAyashah (to her husband) with her, WaYaAkal (and he ate).

Iyanay (The eyes) Shanayamam (their of both) WaThaPaqachanah (and of them were opened), and they WaYaYadaiw (and knew) Iyaramam (that they were naked). WaYaThaparaw (And they sewed) Thaanah (fig) leaves together, WaYaIshahaw (and made themselves) Chagawarath (aprons).

WaYaShamaiw (And they heard) Qawal (the voice) of Yahawah Alahayam MaThaHalak (walking) BaGan (in the garden) LaRawach (in the cool) HaYawam (of the day), HaAdam (and the man) WaAyashahathaw (and his wife) WaYaThaChabaa (and hid themselves) MaPanayam (from the presence) of Yahawah Alahayam Itz (among the trees) HaGan (of the garden).
Yahawah Alahayam WaYaQaraa (and called) HaAdam (to the man), WaYaAmar (and said) to him, “Ay (Where are you)?”
WaYaAmar (And the man said), “Shamaithay (I heard) Qawalak (your voice) BaGan (in the garden), WaAYaraa (and I was afraid), because I Iyaram (was naked); WaAChabaa (and I hid myself).”
Alahayam said, “YaHaNagayad (Who told) Iyaram (you that you were naked)? Akal (Have you eaten) HaItz (from the tree) that I commanded you not Akalath (to eat from)?”
HaAdam (The man) WaYaAmar (and said), “HaAyashah (The woman) Nathanathah (whom you gave) to be with me, she Nathanah (gave) me HaItz (of the tree), and I ate.”

Yahawah Alahayam WaYaAmar (and said) LaAyashah (to the woman), “Ishahayath (What is this you have done)?” HaAyashah (The woman) WaThaAmar (and said), “HaNachash (The serpent) HaNashayaay (deceived me), WaAAkal (and I ate).”

Yahawah Alahayam WaYaAmar (and said) HaNachash (to the serpent), “Because you Ishahayath (have done) this, Arawar (you are cursed) above all livestock, and above every animal HaShadah (of the field). Gachawanak (On your belly) ThaYalak (you shall go), ThaAkal (and you shall eat) Yawamay (dust all the days) Chayath (of your life).

AShayath (I will put) enmity HaAyashah (between you and the woman), Zaraik (and between your offspring) Zaraih (and her offspring). YaShawapak (He will bruise you) Raash (your head), ThaShawapaw (and you will bruise him) Iqab (his heel).”

HaAyashah (To the woman) YaAmar (he said), “I will greatly HaRabah (multiply) your pain in childbirth. In pain ThaYaladay (you will bear) Banayam (children). Thashawaqahathak (Your desire) Ayashak (will be for your husband), YaMashal (and he will rule over you).”

To Adam (Adam) YaAmar (he said), “Shamaith (Because you have listened) Ayashahathak (to your wife's) LaQawal (voice), WaThaAkal (and have eaten) HaItz (of the tree), of which Tzawahayathayak (I commanded you), LaAmar (saying), ‘ThaAkal (You shall not eat) of it,’ Arawarah (cursed) HaAdamah (is the ground) for your sake. BaItzabawan (In toil) ThaAkalah (you will eat her) Kal (of it all) Yawamay (the days) Chayayak (of your life).
It will yield WaQawatz (and thorns) WaDaradar (and thistles) to you; WaAkalath (and you will eat) Ishab (the herb) HaShadah (of the field).

BaZaihath (By the sweat) Apayak (of your face) ThaAkal (will you eat) Lacham (bread) Shawabak (until you return) HaAdamah (to the ground), Laqachath (for out of it you were taken). Ipar (For you are dust), ThaShawab (and to dust you shall return).”
HaAdam (The man) WaYaQaraa (and called) his wife Chawah (Eve), Am (because she was the mother) Chay (of all living).
Yahawah Alahayam WaYaIshah (and made) Kathanathawath (coats) Iwar (of skins) for Adam WaLaAyashahathaw (and for his wife), WaYaLabasham (and clothed them).

Yahawah Alahayam WaYaAmar (and said), “Han (Behold), HaAdam (the man) KaAchad (has become like one) of us, LaYadaith (knowing) Tawab (good) WaRai (and evil). Now, YaShalach (lest he reach) Yadaw (out his hand), WaYaLaqach (and also take) MaItz (of the tree) HaChayayam (the of life - plural), WaYaAkal (and eat), WaYaChayay (and live) LaIwalam (forever)...”
Therefore Yahawah Alahayam WaYaShalachaw (and sent him out from) MaGan (from the garden) of Idan (Eden), LaIbad (to till) HaAdamah (the ground) YaLaqach (from which he was taken).

WaYaGarash (And so he drove out) HaAdam (the man); WaYaShakan (and he placed) Idan (Cherubs) MaQadam (from at the east) LaGan (of the garden) of Idan (Eden), Lahat (and the flame) HaCharab (the of a sword) HaMaThaHapakath (who which turned every way), LaShamar (to guard) Darak (the way) Itz (to the tree) HaChayayam (the of life - plural).

WaHaAdam (And the man) YaYadai (knew) Chawah (Eve) Ayashahathaw (his wife). WaThaHarah (And she conceived), WaThaYalad (and gave birth) to Qayan (Cain), WaThaAmar (and said), “Qanahayathay (I have gotten) Ayash (a man) with Yahawah help.”
Again LaYaladath (she gave birth), Achayaw (his to Cain's brother) Habal (Abel). Habal (Abel) Raih (was a keeper) Tzaan (of sheep), but Qayan (Cain) Ibad (was a tiller) Adamah (of the ground).
Yawamayam (As time - plural) passed, it happened that Qayan (Cain) WaYaBawaa (and brought) Manachah (an offering) to Yahawah MaParay (from the fruit) HaAdamah (of the ground).

Habal (Abel) YaHaBawayaa (also brought) MaBakawarahawath (some of the firstborn - plural) Tzaanaw (of his flock) WaMaChalaban (and their of its fat). Yahawah WaYaShaih (and respected) Habal (Abel) Manachahathaw (and his offering),
But he didn't respect Qayan (Cain) Manachahathaw (and his offering). Qayan (Cain) was very WaYaCharah (and angry), Panayamaw (and the expression on his face) WaYaNapalaw (and fell).
Yahawah WaYaAmar (and said) to Qayan (Cain), “YaCharah (Why are you angry)? Panayamak (Why has the expression of your face) Napalaw (fallen)?

If ThaYatayab (you do well), will it not be lifted up? ThaYatayab (If you don't do well), Chataahath (sin) crouches LaPathach (at the door). Thashawaqahathaw (Its desire) is for you, ThaMashal (but you are to rule over it).”

Qayan (Cain) WaYaAmar (and said) to Habal (Abel), Achayaw (his brother), “BaShadah (Let's go into the field).” It happened when they were in the field, that Qayan (Cain) WaYaQawam (and rose up) Al (against) Habal (Abel), Achayaw (his brother), WaYaHaragaw (and killed him).
Yahawah WaYaAmar (and said) to Qayan (Cain), “Ay (Where) is Habal (Abel), Achayak (your brother)?” WaYaAmar (And he said), “Yadaithay (I don't know). Achay (Am I my brother's keeper)?”
Yahawah said, “Mah (What) Ishahayath (have you done)? Qawal (The voice) Achayak (of your brother's) Damay (blood) Tzaiqayam (cries) HaAdamah (to me from the ground).

Arawar (Now you are cursed) HaAdamah (because of the ground), Patzahathah (which has opened) Pahayah (its mouth) LaLaqachath (to receive) Achayak (your brother's) Damay (blood) MaYadak (from your hand).
Kay (From now on), when ThaIbad (you till) HaAdamah (the ground), it won't Nathanath (yield) Kachah (its strength) to you. Nawai (You shall be a fugitive) and a wanderer BaAratz (in the earth).”
Qayan (Cain) WaYaAmar (and said) to Yahawah, “Iwanay (My punishment) is greater MaNashaa (than I can bear).

Behold, Garashath (you have driven me out) HaYawam (this day) from the surface of the ground. ASathar (I will be hidden) from Panayam (your face), Nawai (and I will be a fugitive) and a wanderer BaAratz (in the earth). WaHayahayathay (And it will happen) Matzaay (that whoever finds me) YaHaragay (will kill me).”

Yahawah WaYaAmar (and said) to him, “Therefore Harag (whoever slays) Qayan (Cain), YaNaqam (vengeance will be taken) on him sevenfold.” Yahawah WaYaShawam (and appointed) Awath (a sign) for Qayan (Cain), LaBalathay (lest) Matzaaw (any finding him) HaNakahawath (him should strike him - plural).
Qayan (Cain) WaYaYatzaa (and went out) from Yahawah MaLaPanayam (from presence), and lived BaAratz (in the land) of Nawad (Nod), Qadamahath (east) of Idan (Eden).

Qayan (Cain) WaYaYadai (and knew) Ayashahathaw (his wife). WaThaHarah (And she conceived), WaThaYalad (and gave birth) to Chanawak (Enoch). Banah (He built) Iyar (a city), WaYaQaraa (and called) Sham (the name) HaIyar (of the city), KaSham (as after the name) Banaw (of his son), Chanawak (Enoch).

To Chanawak (Enoch) WaYaYawalad (and was born) Iyarad (Irad). Iyarad (Irad) became the father of Machawayaal (Mehujael). Machawayaal (Mehujael) became the father of Mathawashaal (Methushael). Mathawashaal (Methushael) became the father of Lamak (Lamech).
Lamak (Lamech) WaYaLaqach (and took) Shanathayam (two) wives: Sham (the name) HaAchath (of the one) was Idah (Adah), WaSham (and the name) of the other Tzalah (Zillah).
Idah (Adah) WaThaYalad (and gave birth) to Yabal (Jabal), Abay (who was the father) Yashab (of those who dwell) Ahal (in tents) and have livestock.
Achayaw (His brother's) WaSham (and name) was Yawabal (Jubal), Abay (who was the father) Thapash (of all who handle) Kanawar (the harp) and pipe.

Tzalah (Zillah) Yaladah (also gave birth) to Thawabalaqayan (Tubal) Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument Nachashath (of brass) WaBarazal (and iron). Thawabalaqayan (Tubal) WaAchawath (And cain's sister) was Naimah (Naamah).

Banay (The sons) of Sham (Shem): Iyalam (Elam), and Ashawar (Asshur), and Arapakashad (Arpachshad), and Lawad (Lud), and Aram (Aram), and Iwatz (Uz), and Chawal (Hul), and Gathar (Gether), and Mashak (Meshech).
Arapakashad (Arpachshad) YaYalad (became the father) of Shalach (Shelah), and Shalach (Shelah) YaYalad (became the father) of Ibar (Eber).

To Ibar (Eber) YaYalad (were born) Shanayam (two) Banayam (sons): Sham (the name) HaAchad (of the one) was Palag (Peleg); BaYawamayaw (for in his days) HaAratz (the earth) NaPalagah (was divided); Achayaw (and his brother's) WaSham (and name) was Yaqatan (Joktan).
Yaqatan (Joktan) YaYalad (became the father) of Alamawadad (Almodad), and Shalap (Sheleph), and Chatzaramawath (Hazarmaveth), and Yarach (Jerah),
And Hadawaram (Hadoram), and Awazal (Uzal), and Daqalah (Diklah),
And Iyabal (Ebal), and Abayamaal (Abimael), and Shabaa (Sheba),
And Awapayar (Ophir), and Chawayalah (Havilah), and Yawabab (Jobab). Banay (All these were the sons) of Yaqatan (Joktan).
Sham (Shem), Arapakashad (Arpachshad), Shalach (Shelah),
Ibar (Eber), Palag (Peleg), Raiw (Reu),
Sharawag (Serug), Nachawar (Nahor), Tharach (Terah),
Abaram (Abram) (the same is Abaraham (Abraham)).
Banay (The sons) of Abaraham (Abraham): Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yashamaial (Ishmael).
Thawaladahawatham (These are their generations): Bakawar (the firstborn) of Yashamaial (Ishmael), Nabayawath (Nebaioth); then Qadar (Kedar), and Adabaal (Adbeel), and Mabasham (Mibsam),
Mashamai (Mishma), and Dawamah (Dumah), Mashaa (Massa), Chadad (Hadad), and Thayamaa (Tema),
Yatawar (Jetur), Napayash (Naphish), and Qadamah (Kedemah). Banay (These are the sons) of Yashamaial (Ishmael).

WaBanay (And the sons) of Qatawarah (Keturah), Abaraham (Abraham's) Payalagash (concubine): Yaladah (she bore) Zamaran (Zimran), and Yaqashan (Jokshan), and Madan (Medan), and Madayan (Midian), and Yashabaq (Ishbak), and Shawach (Shuah). WaBanay (And the sons) of Yaqashan (Jokshan): Shabaa (Sheba), and Dadan (Dedan).

WaBanay (And the sons) of Madayan (Midian): Iyapah (Ephah), and Ipar (Epher), and Chanawak (Hanoch), and Abayadai (Abida), and Aladaih (Eldaah). Banay (All these were the sons) of Qatawarah (Keturah).
Abaraham (Abraham) WaYaYawalad (and became the father) of Yatzachaq (Isaac). Banay (The sons) of Yatzachaq (Isaac): Ishaw (Esau), and Yashar-Al (Israel).
Banay (The sons) of Ishaw (Esau): Alayapaz (Eliphaz), Raiwaal (Reuel), and Yaiwash (Jeush), and Yailam (Jalam), and Qarach (Korah).
Banay (The sons) of Alayapaz (Eliphaz): Thayaman (Teman), and Awamar (Omar), Tzapaw (Zephi), and Gaitham (Gatam), Qanaz (Kenaz), and Thamanai (Timna), and Imalaq (Amalek).
Banay (The sons) of Raiwaal (Reuel): Nachath (Nahath), Zarach (Zerah), Shamah (Shammah), and Mazah (Mizzah).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Shaiyar (Seir): Lawatan (Lotan), and Shawabal (Shobal), and Tzabaiwan (Zibeon), and Inah (Anah), and Dayashawan (Dishon), and Atzar (Ezer), and Dayashan (Dishan).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Lawatan (Lotan): Charay (Hori), and Hawamam (Homam); and Thamanai (Timna) was Lawatan (Lotan's) WaAchawath (and sister).

Banay (The sons) of Shawabal (Shobal): Ilawan (Alian), and Manachath (Manahath), and Iyabal (Ebal), Shapaw (Shephi), and Awanam (Onam). WaBanay (And the sons) of Tzabaiwan (Zibeon): Ayah (Aiah), and Inah (Anah).
Banay (The sons) of Inah (Anah): Dayashawan (Dishon). WaBanay (And the sons) of Dayashawan (Dishon): Chamaran (Hamran), and Ashaban (Eshban), and Yatharan (Ithran), and Karan (Cheran).
Banay (The sons) of Atzar (Ezer): Balahan (Bilhan), and Zaiwan (Zaavan), Yaiqan (Jaakan). Banay (The sons) of Dishan: Iwatz (Uz), and Aran (Aran).

HaMalakayam (Now these are the kings) Malakaw (who reigned) BaAratz (in the land) of Adawam (Edom), LaPanayam (before) Malak (there reigned) Malak (any king) LaBanay (over the children) of Yashar-Al (Israel): Balai (Bela) Ban (the son) of Baiwar (Beor); WaSham (and the name) Iyaraw (of his city) was Danahabah (Dinhabah).
Balai (Bela) WaYaMawath (and died), and Yawabab (Jobab) Ban (the son) of Zarach (Zerah) of Batzarah (Bozrah) WaYaMalak (and reigned in his place).
Yawabab (Jobab) WaYaMawath (and died), and Chawasham (Husham) MaAratz (of the land) HaThayamanay (of the Temanites) WaYaMalak (and reigned in his place).

Chawasham (Husham) WaYaMawath (and died), and Hadad (Hadad) Ban (the son) of Badad (Bedad), HaMaNakah (who who struck) Madayan (Midian) BaShadah (in the field) of Mawaab (Moab), WaYaMalak (and reigned) in his place; WaSham (and the name) Iyaraw (of his city) was Iwayath (Avith).
Hadad (Hadad) WaYaMawath (and died), and Shamalah (Samlah) of Masharaqah (Masrekah) WaYaMalak (and reigned in his place).
Shamalah (Samlah) WaYaMawath (and died), and Shaawal (Shaul) of Rachabawath (Rehoboth) HaNahar (by the River) WaYaMalak (and reigned in his place).
Shaawal (Shaul) WaYaMawath (and died), and Bailachanan (Baal Hanan) Ban (the son) of Ikabawar (Achbor) WaYaMalak (and reigned in his place).

Bailachanan (Baal Hanan) WaYaMawath (and died), and Hadad (Hadad) WaYaMalak (and reigned) in his place; WaSham (and the name) Iyaraw (of his city) was Paiw (Pai): Ayashahathaw (and his wife's) WaSham (and name) was Mahayatabaal (Mehetabel), Banath (the daughter) of Matarad (Matred), Banath (the daughter) of Mayazahab (Mezahab).
Hadad (Hadad) WaYaMawath (and died). The chiefs of Adawam (Edom) were: chief Thamanai (Timna), chief Ilawah (Aliah), chief Yathath (Jetheth),
Chief Ahalayabamah (Oholibamah), chief Alah (Elah), chief Payanan (Pinon),
Chief Qanaz (Kenaz), chief Thayaman (Teman), chief Mabatzar (Mibzar),
Chief Magadayaal (Magdiel), chief Iyaram (Iram). These are the chiefs of Adawam (Edom).
Banay (These are the sons) of Yashar-Al (Israel): Raawaban (Reuben), Shamaiwan (Simeon), Laway (Levi), and Yahawadah (Judah), Yashashakar (Issachar), and Zabawalawan (Zebulun),
Dan (Dan), Yawasap (Joseph), and Banayamayan (Benjamin), Napathalay (Naphtali), Gad (Gad), and Ashar (Asher).

Banay (The sons) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ir (Er), and Awanan (Onan), and Shalah (Shelah); Shalawashah (which three) YaNaYawalad (were born) to him of Shawaia (Shua's) MaBanath (from daughter) the Canaanitess. Ir (Er), Yahawadah (Judah's) Bakawar (firstborn), Rai (was wicked) BaIyanay (in the sight) of Yahawah; WaYaMawayathaw (and he killed him).
Thamar (Tamar) Kalahathaw (his daughter-in-law) Yaladah (bore) him Paratz (Perez) and Zarach (Zerah). Banay (All the sons) of Yahawadah (Judah) Chamashah (were five).
Banay (The sons) of Paratz (Perez): Chatzarawan (Hezron), and Chamawal (Hamul).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Zarach (Zerah): Zamaray (Zimri), and Ayathan (Ethan), and Hayaman (Heman), and Kalakal (Calcol), and Darai (Dara); Chamashah (five of them in all).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Karamay (Carmi): Ikar (Achar), the troubler of Yashar-Al (Israel), YaMail (who committed a trespass) BaCharam (in the devoted thing).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Ayathan (Ethan): Izarayah (Azariah).
WaBanay (And the sons) also of Chatzarawan (Hezron), YaNaYawalad (who were born) to him: Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel), and Ram (Ram), and Kalawabay (Chelubai).

Ram (Ram) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Imayanadab (Amminadab), and Imayanadab (Amminadab) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Nachashawan (Nahshon), Nashayaa (prince) Banay (of the children) of Yahawadah (Judah);
And Nachashawan (Nahshon) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Shalamaa (Salma), and Shalamaa (Salma) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Baiz (Boaz),
And Baiz (Boaz) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Iwabad (Obed), and Iwabad (Obed) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Yashay (Jesse);
And Yashay (Jesse) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) Bakawaraw (of his firstborn) Alayaab (Eliab), and Abayanadab (Abinadab) HaShanay (the second), and Shamaia (Shimea) HaShalayashay (the third),
Nathanaal (Nethanel) HaRabayaiy (the fourth), Raday (Raddai) HaChamayashay (the fifth),
Atzam (Ozem) HaShashay (the sixth), Dawad (David) HaShabayaiy (the seventh);

WaAchawathayathayam (and their sisters) were Tzarawayah (Zeruiah) and Abayagayal (Abigail). WaBanay (And the sons) of Tzarawayah (Zeruiah): Abayashay (Abishai), and Yawaab (Joab), and Ishahaal (Asahel), Shalawashah (three).
Abayagayal (Abigail) Yaladah (bore) Imashaa (Amasa); WaAbay (and the father) of Imashaa (Amasa) was Yathar (Jether) the Yashamaialay (Ishmaelite).

Kalab (Caleb) Ban (the son) of Chatzarawan (Hezron) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of children of Izawabah (Azubah) Ayashah (his wife), and of Yarayaiwath (Jerioth); Banayah (and these were her sons): Yashar (Jesher), and Shawabab (Shobab), and Aradawan (Ardon).
Izawabah (Azubah) WaThaMawath (and died), and Kalab (Caleb) WaYaLaqach (and took) to him aparath (ephrath), WaThaYalad (and who bore) him Chawar (Hur).
Chawar (Hur) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Awaray (Uri), and Awaray (Uri) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Batzalaal (Bezalel).

Afterward Chatzarawan (Hezron) YaBawaa (went in) Banath (to the daughter) of Makayar (Machir) Abay (the father) of Galaid (Gilead), Laqachah (whom he took as wife her) Shashayam (when he was sixty) Shanah (years) Ban (old); WaThaYalad (and she bore) him Shagawab (Segub).
Shagawab (Segub) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Yaayar (Jair), Iyarayam (who had twenty - three cities) BaAratz (in the land) of Galaid (Gilead).

Gashawar (Geshur) and Aram (Aram) WaYaLaqach (and took) Chawahath (the towns) of Yaayar (Jair) from them, with Qanath (Kenath), and its villages, Shashayam (even sixty) Iyar (cities). Banay (All these were the sons) of Makayar (Machir) Abay (the father) of Galaid (Gilead).

WaAchar (And after) that Chatzarawan (Hezron) Mawath (was dead) in Kalabaaparathah (Caleb Ephrathah), then Abayah (Abijah) Chatzarawan (Hezron's) WaAyashahath (and wife) WaThaYalad (and bore) him Ashachawar (Ashhur) Abay (the father) of Thaqawai (Tekoa).

Banay (The sons) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) Bakawar (the firstborn) of Chatzarawan (Hezron) were Ram (Ram) HaBakawar (the firstborn), and Bawanah (Bunah), and Aran (Oren), and Atzam (Ozem), Achayah (Ahijah).
Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) Acharath (had another) Ayashah (wife), WaShamah (and her whose name) was Itarah (Atarah); Am (she was the mother) of Awanam (Onam).
Banay (The sons) of Ram (Ram) Bakawar (the firstborn) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) were Maitz (Maaz), and Yamayan (Jamin), and Iqar (Eker).
Banay (The sons) of Awanam (Onam) were Shamay (Shammai), and Yadai (Jada). WaBanay (And the sons) of Shamay (Shammai): Nadab (Nadab), and Abayashawar (Abishur).
WaSham (And the name) Ayashahath (of the wife) of Abayashawar (Abishur) was Abayahayal (Abihail); WaThaYalad (and she bore) him Achaban (Ahban), and Mawalayad (Molid).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Nadab (Nadab): Salad (Seled), and Apayam (Appaim); but Salad (Seled) WaYaMawath (and died) Banayam (without children).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Apayam (Appaim): Yashaiy (Ishi). WaBanay (And the sons) of Yashaiy (Ishi): Shashan (Sheshan). WaBanay (And the sons) of Shashan (Sheshan): Achalay (Ahlai).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Yadai (Jada) Achay (the brother) of Shamay (Shammai): Yathar (Jether), and Yawanathan (Jonathan); and Yathar (Jether) WaYaMawath (and died) Banayam (without children).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Yawanathan (Jonathan): Palath (Peleth), and Zazaa (Zaza). Banay (These were the sons) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel).
Now Shashan (Sheshan) Banayam (had no sons), Banathawath (but daughters). Shashan (Sheshan) Ibad (had a servant), an Matzaray (Egyptian), WaShamaw (and his whose name) was Yarachai (Jarha).
Shashan (Sheshan) WaYaNathan (and gave) Banathaw (his daughter) to Yarachai (Jarha) Ibadaw (his servant) LaAyashah (as wife); WaThaYalad (and she bore) him Ithay (Attai).
Ithay (Attai) YaHaYalayad (became the father) of Nathan (Nathan), and Nathan (Nathan) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Zabad (Zabad),
And Zabad (Zabad) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Apalal (Ephlal), and Apalal (Ephlal) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Iwabad (Obed),
And Iwabad (Obed) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Yahawaa (Jehu), and Yahawaa (Jehu) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Izarayah (Azariah),
And Izarayah (Azariah) YaHaYalayad (became the father) of Chalatz (Helez), and Chalatz (Helez) YaHaYalayad (became the father) of Alaishah (Eleasah),
And Alaishah (Eleasah) YaHaYalayad (became the father) of Sasamay (Sismai), and Sasamay (Sismai) YaHaYalayad (became the father) of Shalawam (Shallum),
And Shalawam (Shallum) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Yaqamayah (Jekamiah), and Yaqamayah (Jekamiah) YaHaYalayad (became the father) of Alayashamai (Elishama).

WaBanay (And the sons) of Kalab (Caleb) Achay (the brother) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) were Mayashai (Mesha) Bakawaraw (his firstborn), Abay (who was the father) of Zayap (Ziph); WaBanay (and the sons) of Maraashah (Mareshah) Abay (the father) of Chabarawan (Hebron).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Chabarawan (Hebron): Qarach (Korah), and Thapawach (Tappuah), and Raqam (Rekem), and Shamai (Shema).
Shamai (Shema) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Racham (Raham), YaHaYawalayad (the father) of Yaraqaim (Jorkeam); and Raqam (Rekem) YaHaYawalayad (became the father) of Shamay (Shammai).
WaBan (And the son) of Shamay (Shammai) was maiwan (maon); and maiwan (maon) Abay (was the father) of Bayathatzawar (Beth Zur).
Iyapah (Ephah), Kalab (Caleb's) Payalagash (concubine), Yaladah (bore) Charan (Haran), and Mawatzaa (Moza), and Gazaz (Gazez); and Charan (Haran) YaHaYalayad (became the father) of Gazaz (Gazez).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Yahaday (Jahdai): Ragam (Regem), and Yawatham (Jothan), and Gayashan (Geshan), and Palat (Pelet), and Iyapah (Ephah), and Shaip (Shaaph).
Maikah (Maacah), Kalab (Caleb's) Payalagash (concubine), YaYalad (bore) Shabar (Sheber) and Tharachanah (Tirhanah).

WaThaYalad (And she bore) also Shaip (Shaaph) Abay (the father) of Madamanah (Madmannah), Shawaa (Sheva) Abay (the father) of Makabanaa (Machbena), WaAbay (and the father) of Gabaia (Gibea); WaBanath (and the daughter) of Kalab (Caleb) was Ikasah (Achsah).
Banay (These were the sons) of Kalab (Caleb), Ban (the son) of Chawar (Hur), Bakawar (the firstborn) of Ephrathah: Shawabal (Shobal) Abay (the father) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim),
Shalamaa (Salma) Abay (the father) of Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem), Charap (Hareph) Abay (the father) of Bayathagadar (Beth Gader).
Shawabal (Shobal) Abay (the father) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim) Banayam (had sons): Raah (Haroeh), Chatzay (half) of the Menuhoth.

WaMashapachahawath (And the families) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim): HaYatharay (The Ithrites), and the Puthites, WaHaShamathay (and the Shumathites), WaHaMasharaiy (and the Mishraites); Yatzaaw (of them came) the Tzaraiy (Zorathites) and the Ashathaalay (Eshtaolites).

Banay (The sons) of Shalamaa (Salma): Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem), and the Natapathay (Netophathites), Atroth Beth itarawathabayathayawaab (joab), WaChatzay (and half) of the Manahathites, HaTzaraiy (the Zorites).

WaMashapachahawath (And the families) Saparayam (of scribes) who lived at Yaibatz (Jabez): Tharaithayam (the Tirathites), Shamaithayam (the Shimeathites), the Sucathites. These are the Qayanay (Kenites) HaBawaayam (who who came - plural) of Chamath (Hammath), Abay (the father) Bayath (of the house) of Rakab (Rechab).

Banay (Now these were the sons) of Dawad (David), YaNaYawalad (who were born) to him in Chabarawan (Hebron): HaBakawar (the firstborn), Amanawan (Amnon), of Achayanaim (Ahinoam) HaYazaraialayath (the Jezreelitess); Shanay (the second), Danayaal (Daniel), of Abayagayal (Abigail) HaKaramalayath (the Carmelitess);

HaShalayashay (the third), Abayashalawam (Absalom) Ban (the son) of Maikah (Maacah) Banath (the daughter) of Thalamay (Talmai) Malak (king) of Gashawar (Geshur); HaRabayaiy (the fourth), Adanayah (Adonijah) Ban (the son) of Chagayath (Haggith);
HaChamayashay (the fifth), Shapatayah (Shephatiah) of Abayatal (Abital); HaShashay (the sixth), Yatharaim (Ithream) by Igalah (Eglah) Ayashahathaw (his wife):

Shashah (six) YaNaYawalad (were born) to him in Chabarawan (Hebron); WaYaMalak (and there he reigned) Shabai (seven) Shanahayam (years) WaShashah (and six) Chadashayam (months). In Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) YaMalak (he reigned) WaShalawashayam (and thirty) - WaShalawash (and three) Shanah (years);

NaYawaladaw (and these were born) to him in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): Shamaia (Shimea), and Shawabab (Shobab), and Nathan (Nathan), and Shalamah (Solomon), Arabaih (four), of Bathashawai (Bathshua) Banath (the daughter) of Imayaal (Ammiel);
And Yabachar (Ibhar), and Alayashamai (Elishama), and Alayapalat (Eliphelet),
And Nagah (Nogah), and Napag (Nepheg), and Yapayai (Japhia),
And Alayashamai (Elishama), and Alayadai (Eliada), and Alayapalat (Eliphelet), Thashaih (nine).
Banay (All these were the sons) of Dawad (David), Banay (besides the sons) Payalagashayam (of the concubines); and Thamar (Tamar) Achawatham (was their sister).
Shalamah (Solomon's) WaBan (and son) was Rachabaim (Rehoboam), Abayah (Abijah) Banaw (his son), Asaa (Asa) Banaw (his son), Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) Banaw (his son),
Yawaram (Joram) Banaw (his son), Achazayah (Ahaziah) Banaw (his son), Yawaash (Joash) Banaw (his son),
Amatzayah (Amaziah) Banaw (his son), Izarayah (Azariah) Banaw (his son), Yawatham (Jotham) Banaw (his son),
Achaz (Ahaz) Banaw (his son), Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) Banaw (his son), Manashah (Manasseh) Banaw (his son),
Amawan (Amon) Banaw (his son), Yaashayah (Josiah) Banaw (his son).

WaBanay (And the sons) of Yaashayah (Josiah): HaBakawar (the firstborn) Yawachanan (Johanan), HaShanay (the second) Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), HaShalayashay (the third) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), HaRabayaiy (the fourth) Shalawam (Shallum).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim): Yakanayah (Jeconiah) Banaw (his son), Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) Banaw (his son).
WaBanay (And the sons) of Yakanayah (Jeconiah), the Asayar (captive): Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel) Banaw (his son),
And Malakayaram (Malchiram), and Padayah (Pedaiah), and Shanaatzar (Shenazzar), Yaqamayah (Jekamiah), Hawashamai (Hoshama), and Nadabayah (Nedabiah).

WaBanay (And the sons) of Padayah (Pedaiah): Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and Shamaiy (Shimei). WaBan (And the sons) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel): Mashalam (Meshullam), and Chananayah (Hananiah); and Shalamayath (Shelomith) Achawatham (was their sister);
And Chashabah (Hashubah), and Ahal (Ohel), and Barakayah (Berechiah), and Chasadayah (Hasadiah), Yawashabachasad (Jushab Hesed), Chamash (five).

WaBan (And the sons) of Chananayah (Hananiah): Palatayah (Pelatiah), and Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah); Banay (the sons) of Rapayah (Rephaiah), Banay (the sons) of Aranan (Arnan), Banay (the sons) of Ibadayah (Obadiah), Banay (the sons) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah).

WaBanay (And the sons) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah). WaBanay (And the sons) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah): Chatawash (Hattush), and Yagaal (Igal), and Barayach (Bariah), and Nairayah (Neariah), and Shapat (Shaphat), Shashah (six).
WaBan (And the sons) of Nairayah (Neariah): Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), and Chazaqayah (Hizkiah), and Izarayaqam (Azrikam), Shalawashah (three).

WaBanay (And the sons) of Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai): Hawadayawahaw (Hodaviah), and Alayashayab (Eliashib), and Palayah (Pelaiah), and Iqawab (Akkub), and Yawachanan (Johanan), and Dalayah (Delaiah), and Inanay (Anani), Shabaih (seven).

Moreover Yahweh answered Job,

Then answered Yahweh,

Then Yahweh answered out of the whirlwind,
“Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

“Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
“See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
His bones are like tubes of brass. His limbs are like bars of iron.
He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn't tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

“ThaYaraa (But don't you be afraid), Yaiqab (Jacob) Ibaday (my servant), ThaChathath (neither be dismayed), Yashar-Al (Israel): for, behold, MaYawashaik (I will save you) MaRachawaq (you from afar), Zaraik (and your seed) MaAratz (from the land) Shabayam (of their captivity); and Yaiqab (Jacob) WaYaShawab (and shall return), WaYaShaqat (and shall be quiet) WaYaShaanan (and at ease them), MaCharayad (and none shall make him afraid).

ThaYaraa (Don't you be afraid), O Yaiqab (Jacob) Ibaday (my servant),” Naam (says) Yahawah; “for I am with you: AIshah (for I will make) Kalah (a full end) HaGawayam (of all the nations) HaNadachathayak (where I have driven you) you; AIshah (but I will not make) Kalah (a full end) of you, WaYasarathayak (and I will correct you) LaMashapat (you in measure), WaNaqah (and will in no way) ANaqahak (leave you unpunished).”
Dabar (The word) of Yahawah that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) HaNabayaa (the prophet) concerning the Palashathay (Philistines), before that Paraih (Pharaoh) YaNakah (struck) Izah (Gaza).

YaAmar (Thus says) Yahawah: “Behold, Mayam (waters) Ilahayam (rise up - plural) MaTzapawan (out of the north), Shawatap (and shall become an overflowing) LaNachal (stream), WaYaShatapaw (and shall overflow) Aratz (the land) WaMalawaah (and her all that is therein), Iyar (the city) WaYashabay (and those who dwell) therein; HaAdam (and the men) WaZaiqaw (and shall cry), Yawashab (and all the inhabitants) HaAratz (of the land) shall wail.

MaQawal (From at the noise) Shaitahath (of the stamping) Parasahawath (of the hoofs) Abayarayaw (of his strong) ones, MaRaish (from at the rushing) LaRakabaw (of his chariots), Hamawan (at the rumbling) Galagalayaw (of his wheels), Abawath (the fathers) HaPanahaw (don't look back) Banayam (to their children) MaRapayawan (from for feebleness) Yadayam (of hands);

HaYawam (because of the day) HaBawaa (that comes) LaShadawad (to destroy) all the Palashathay (Philistines), LaHaKarayath (to cut off) from Tzar (Tyre) and Tzayadawan (Sidon) Izar (every helper) Sharayad (who remains): for Yahawah Shadad (will destroy) the Palashathay (Philistines), Shaarayath (the remnant) Ay (of the isle) of Kapathar (Caphtor).

Qarachah (Baldness) Bawaah (has come) on Izah (Gaza); Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) NaDamahathah (is brought to nothing), Shaarayath (the remnant) Imaqam (of their valley): ThaThagawadaday (how long will you cut yourself)?
“‘You Charab (sword) of Yahawah, Laa (how long will it be before) ThaShaqatay (you be quiet)? HaAsapay (Put up) Thairak (yourself into your scabbard); HaRagaiy (rest), and be still.’
“ThaShaqatay (How can you be quiet), since Yahawah YaTzawah (has given you a command)? Against Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon), and against the seashore, Yaidah (there has he appointed it).”

Of Mawaab (Moab). YaAmar (Thus says) Yahawah Tzabaawath (of Armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): “Haway (Woe) to Nabaw (Nebo)! Shadadah (for it is laid waste); Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim) is disappointed, NaLakadah (it is taken); HaMashagab (The misgab) HaYabayashah (is put to shame) and broken down.

Thahalahath (The praise) of Mawaab (Moab) is no more; in Chashabawan (Heshbon) Chashabaw (they have devised) Raih (evil) against her: ‘Yalakaw (Come), WaNaKarayathah (and let us cut her off) MaGaway (from being a nation).’ You also, Madaman (Madmen), shall be brought to silence: Charab (the sword) ThaYalak (shall pursue) you.
Qawal (The sound) Qawal (of a cry) from Charanayam (Horonaim), Shad (desolation) Gadawal (and great) Shad (destruction)!
Mawaab (Moab) NaShabarah (is destroyed); Tzaiyawarayah (her little ones) Zaiqah (have caused a cry) HaShamayaiw (to be heard).

Mailah (For by the ascent) of Lawachayath (Luhith) with continual BaBakay (in weeping) YaIlah (shall they go up); for at the descent of Charanayam (Horonaim) they Shamaiw (have heard) Tzaiqahath (the distress of the cry) Shabar (of destruction).
Nawasaw (Flee), Malataw (save) your lives, and be like the heath BaMadabar (in the wilderness).

For, Batachak (because you have trusted) BaMaishahayak (in your works) WaBaAwatzarawathayak (and in your treasures), ThaLakaday (you also shall be taken): and Kamawash (Chemosh) WaYaYatzaa (and shall go forth) BaGawalah (into captivity), Kahanayaw (his priests) WaSharayaw (and his princes) Yachad (together).

Shadad (The destroyer) WaYaBawaa (and shall come) Iyar (on every city), WaIyar (and no city) ThaMalat (shall escape); HaImaq (the valley) WaYaAbad (and also shall perish), HaMayashawar (and the plain) shall be destroyed; as Yahawah YaAmar (has spoken).

Nathanaw (Give) Tzayatz (wings) to Mawaab (Moab), that she may fly ThaYatzaa (and get her away): WaIyarayah (and her cities) LaShamah (shall become a desolation), Yawashab (without any to dwell) therein.
“Arawar (Cursed) Ishah (is he who does) Malaakahath (the work) of Yahawah negligently; WaArawar (and cursed) Manai (is he who keeps back) Charabaw (his sword) MaDam (from blood).

“Mawaab (Moab) YaShaanan (has been at ease them) MaNaiwarayaw (from his youth), WaShaqat (and he has settled) Shamarayaw (on his lees), YaHaRawaraq (and has not been emptied) MaKalay (from vessel) Kalay (to vessel), YaHalak (neither has he gone) WaBaGawalah (and into captivity): Taimaw (therefore his taste) YaImad (remains) in him, WaRayachaw (and his scent) YaNaMawar (is not changed).

Therefore, behold, Yawamayam (the days) Bawaayam (come - plural),” Naam (says) Yahawah, “WaShalachathay (and that I will send) to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; YaRawayaqaw (and they shall empty) WaKalayaw (and his vessels), YaNapatzaw (and break) WaNabalayam (and their bottles in pieces).
Mawaab (Moab) WaYaBawash (and shall be ashamed) of Kamawash (Chemosh), Bayath (as the house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) Bawashaw (was ashamed) of Bayath-Al (Bethel) Mabatacham (their confidence).
“ThaAmaraw (How do you say), ‘Gabawarayam (We are mighty - plural) Chayal (men), and valiant Gabawarayam (men) LaMalachamah (for the war)?’

Mawaab (Moab) YaShadad (is laid waste), YaIlah (and they are gone up) WaIyarayah (and her into his cities), WaMabachar (and his chosen) Bachawarayaw (his young men) Yaradaw (are gone down) LaTabach (to the slaughter),” Naam (says) HaMalak (the King), Shamaw (his whose name) is Yahawah Tzabaawath (of Armies).
“Ayad (The calamity) of Mawaab (Moab) Qarawab (is near) LaBawaa (to come), WaRaithaw (and his affliction) hurries Maad (fast).

All you who are around him, Nawadaw (bemoan) him, Yadaiy (and all you who know) Shamaw (his name); Amaraw (say), ‘Iz (How is the strong) Matah (staff) YaNaShabar (broken), Thapaarah (the beautiful) Maqal (rod)!’

“Banath (You daughter) Yashabay (who dwells) in Dayabawan (Dibon), Yaraday (come down) MaKabawad (from your glory), Yashabath (and sit) BaTzamaa (in thirst); Shadad (for the destroyer) of Mawaab (Moab) YaIlah (has come) up against you, YaShachath (he has destroyed) your strongholds.

Yawashabath (Inhabitant) of Irawair (Aroer), Imaday (stand) Darak (by the way), WaTzapahay (and watch): Shaalay (ask) Nawas (him who flees), WaNaMalatah (and her who escapes); Amaray (say), ‘NaHayahathah (What has been done)?’
Mawaab (Moab) is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail WaZaiqay (and cry); HaNagayadaw (tell) it by the Aranawan (Arnon), that Mawaab (Moab) YaShadad (is laid waste).
WaMashapat (And judgment) YaBawaa (has come) HaMayashawar (on the plain) Aratz (country), on Chalawan (Holon), and on Yahatz (Jahzah), and on Mawapaith (Mephaath),
And on Dayabawan (Dibon), and on Nabaw (Nebo), and on Bayathadabalathayam (Beth Diblathaim),
And on Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim), and on Bayathagamawal (Beth Gamul), and on Bayathabailamaiwan (Beth Meon),

And on Qarayawath (Kerioth), and on Batzarah (Bozrah), Iyaray (and on all the cities) Aratz (of the land) of Mawaab (Moab), HaRachawaqawath (the far - plural) WaHaQarawabawath (and the or near - plural).
Qaran (The horn) of Mawaab (Moab) NaGadaih (is cut off), WaZarawaiw (and his arm) NaShabarah (is broken),” Naam (says) Yahawah.

“HaShakayaraw (Make him drunken); YaHaGadayal (for he magnified) himself against Yahawah: and Mawaab (Moab) WaYaSapaq (and shall wallow) BaQayaaw (in his vomit), LaShachawaq (and he also shall be in derision).
For wasn't Yashar-Al (Israel) HaShachawaq (the a derision) to you? NaMatzaah (was he found) among thieves? For as often Dabarayak (as you speak) of him, ThaThanawadad (you shake your head).

Yashabay (You inhabitants) of Mawaab (Moab), Izabaw (leave) Iyarayam (the cities), Yashabay (and dwell) BaSalai (in the rock); KaYawanah (and be like the dove) ThaQanan (that makes her nest) over Pahay (the mouth) of the abyss.

“Shamainaw (We have heard) Gaawan (of the pride) of Mawaab (Moab). He is very Gaah (proud); Gabahaw (his loftiness), WaGaawanaw (and his pride), and his arrogance, WaRawam (and the haughtiness) Labaw (of his heart).
Yadaithay (I know) Ibarahathaw (his wrath),” Naam (says) Yahawah, “that it is nothing; his boastings Ishahaw (have worked nothing).
Therefore will I wail for Mawaab (Moab); yes, AZaiq (I will cry out) for all Mawaab (Moab): Ayanashay (for the men) of Qayaracharash (Kir Heres) YaHagah (shall they mourn).

MaBakay (With more than the weeping) of Yaizayar (Jazer) ABakah (will I weep) for you, HaGapan (the vine) of Shabam (Sibmah): your branches Ibaraw (passed over) Yam (the sea), Nagaiw (they reached) Yam (even to the sea) of Yaizayar (Jazer): Qayatzak (on your summer fruits) Batzayarak (and on your vintage) Shadad (the destroyer) YaNapal (is fallen).

WaGayal (And gladness) Shamachah (and joy) WaNaAsapah (and is taken) MaKaramal (away from the fruitful field) WaMaAratz (and from the land) of Mawaab (Moab); WaYayan (and I have caused wine) HaShabathathay (to cease) MaYaqabayam (from the wine presses): YaDarak (none shall tread) Hayadad (with shouting); Hayadad (the shouting) Hayadad (shall be no shouting).

MaZaiqath (From the cry) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) even to Alailaa (Elealeh), even to Yahatz (Jahaz) Nathanaw (have they uttered) Qawalam (their voice), from Tzair (Zoar) even to Charanayam (Horonaim), to Eglath Shelishiyah: Mayamay (for the waters) of Namarayam (Nimrim) LaMashamahawath (also shall become desolate - plural).

WaHaShabathathay (and Moreover I will cause to cease) in Mawaab (Moab),” Naam (says) Yahawah, “MaIlah (him who offers) Bamah (in the high place), WaMaQatayar (and him who burns incense) to his Alahayam.

Labay (Therefore my heart) YaHamah (sounds) for Mawaab (Moab) KaChalayalayam (like pipes), WaLabay (and my heart) YaHamah (sounds) KaChalayalayam (like pipes) Ayanashay (for the men) of Qayaracharash (Kir Heres): Yatharahath (therefore the abundance) YaIshah (that he has gotten) Abadaw (is perished).
Raash (For every head) Qarachah (is bald), Zaqan (and every beard) Garaih (clipped): Yadayam (on all the hands) are cuttings, and on the waist sackcloth.

On all the housetops of Mawaab (Moab) WaBaRachabathayah (and in its streets) Masapad (there is lamentation) every where; Shabarathay (for I have broken) Mawaab (Moab) KaKalay (like a vessel) Chapatz (in which none delights),” Naam (says) Yahawah.

“How it is broken down! How they wail! How Mawaab (Moab) YaHaPanah (has turned) Irap (the back) with shame! So shall Mawaab (Moab) LaShachawaq (become a derision) WaLaMachathah (and a terror) to all who are around him.”
YaAmar (For thus says) Yahawah: “Behold, YaDaah (he shall fly) KaNashar (as an eagle), WaYaParash (and shall spread) Kanapayaw (out his wings) against Mawaab (Moab).

Qarayawath (Kerioth) NaLakadah (is taken), and the strongholds are seized, Lab (and the heart) Gabawaray (of the mighty men) of Mawaab (Moab) BaYawam (at that day) KaLab (shall be as the heart) Ayashah (of a woman) MaTzararah (in her pangs).
Mawaab (Moab) shall be destroyed MaIm (from being a people), YaHaGadayal (because he has magnified) himself against Yahawah.
Pachad (Fear), WaPachath (and the pit), WaPach (and the snare), are on you, Yawashab (inhabitant) of Mawaab (Moab),” Naam (says) Yahawah.

“He who flees from HaPachad (the fear) YaNapal (shall fall) HaPachath (into the pit); WaHaIlah (and who he who gets up) HaPachath (out of the pit) YaLakad (shall be taken) BaPach (in the snare): ABawayaa (for I will bring) on him, even on Mawaab (Moab), Shanahath (the year) Paqadahatham (of their visitation),” Naam (says) Yahawah.

“Nawasayam (Those who fled - plural) Imadaw (stand) MaKach (from without strength) BaTzal (in under the shadow) of Chashabawan (Heshbon); Ash (for a fire) YaYatzaa (is gone forth) out of Chashabawan (Heshbon), WaLahabah (and a flame) from the midst of Sayachawan (Sihon), WaThaAkal (and has devoured) Paahath (the corner) of Mawaab (Moab), WaQadaqad (and the crown of the head) of the tumultuous Banay (ones).

Away (Woe) to you, O Mawaab (Moab)! Im (the people) of Kamawash (Chemosh) YaAbad (is undone); Banayak (for your sons) Laqachaw (are taken) BaShabay (in away captive), WaBanathathayak (and your daughters) BaShabayah (into captivity).

“WaShawabathay (And yet will I bring back) Shabawath (the captivity) of Mawaab (Moab) BaAcharayath (in the latter) HaYawamayam (the days),” Naam (says) Yahawah. Hanah (Thus far) Mashapat (is the judgment) of Mawaab (Moab).

LaBanay (Of the children of Ammon). YaAmar (Thus says) Yahawah: “Has Yashar-Al (Israel) HaBanayam (no sons)? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam Yawarash (possess) Gad (Gad), WaImaw (and his people) YaYashab (dwell) BaIyarayaw (in its cities)?

Therefore, behold, Yawamayam (the days) Bawaayam (come - plural),” YaAmar (says) Yahawah, “Tharawaihath (that I will cause an alarm) Malachamah (of war) WaHaShamaithay (and to be heard) against Rabah (Rabbah) Banay (of the children of Ammon); Shamamah (and it shall become a desolate) LaThal (heap), WaBanathathayah (and her daughters) ThaYatzathanah (shall be burned) BaAsh (with fire): then shall Yashar-Al (Israel) WaYaYarash (and possess) Yarashayaw (those who possessed him) him,” Naam (says) Yahawah.

“Wail, Chashabawan (Heshbon), for Iy (Ai) Shadadah (is laid waste); Tzaiqanah (cry), Banathawath (you daughters) of Rabah (Rabbah), clothe yourself in sackcloth: Sapadanah (lament), WaHathaShawatatanah (and run back and forth) among the fences; for Malcam YaYalak (shall go) BaGawalah (into captivity), Kahanayaw (his priests) WaSharayaw (and his princes) Yachadayaw (together).

Why do you glory BaImaqayam (in the valleys), Zawab (your flowing) Imaqak (your valley), HaShawababah (the backsliding) HaBanath (the daughter)? HaBatachah (who who trusted) BaAwatzarathayah (in her treasures), saying, ‘YaBawaa (Who shall come to me)?’

Behold, MaBawayaa (I will bring) Pachad (a fear) on you,” Naam (says) the Adanay, Yahawah Tzabaawath (of Armies), “from all who are around you; WaNaNadachatham (and you shall be driven out) Ayash (every man) LaPanayamaw (his right forth), MaQabatz (and there shall be none to gather together) the fugitives.
“But afterward AShawayab (I will bring back) Shabawath (the captivity) Banay (of the children) of Imawan (Ammon),” Naam (says) Yahawah.

Of Adawam (Edom). YaAmar (Thus says) Yahawah Tzabaawath (of Armies): “Chakamah (Is wisdom) no more in Thayaman (Teman)? Itzah (is counsel) Abadah (perished) MaBayanayam (from the prudent - plural)? Chakamahatham (is their wisdom) vanished?

Nawasaw (Flee), HaPanahaw (turn back), LaYashabath (dwell) HaImayaqaw (in the depths), Yashabay (inhabitants) of Dadan (Dedan); HaBawaathay (for I will bring) Ayad (the calamity) of Ishaw (Esau) on him, Ith (the time) Paqadathayaw (that I shall visit him).

Batzarayam (If grape gatherers) Bawaaw (came) to you, YaShaaraw (would they not leave) Iwalalahawath (some gleaning grapes)? If thieves BaLayalah (by night), HaShachayathaw (wouldn't they destroy) Dayam (their until they had enough)?

But I have made Ishaw (Esau) Chashapathay (bare), Galahayathay (I have uncovered) Masatharayaw (his secret places), YaYawakal (and he shall not be able) WaYaNaChabah (and to hide) himself: Zaraiw (his seed) YaShadad (is destroyed), WaAchayaw (and his brothers), and his neighbors; and he is no more.
Izabah (Leave - emphatic) Yathawamayak (your fatherless children), AChayah (I will preserve them alive); WaAlamanahathayak (and let your widows) ThaBatachaw (trust in me him).”

YaAmar (For thus says) Yahawah: “Behold, they to whom it didn't pertain LaShathahawath (to drink - plural) HaKawas (of the cup) Shathahaw (shall certainly him) YaShathahaw (drink); Naqah (and are you he who shall altogether) ThaNaNaqah (go unpunished)? ThaNaNaqah (You shall not go unpunished), Shathah (but you shall surely) ThaShathah (drink).

NaShabaithay (For I have sworn) by myself,” Naam (says) Yahawah, “that Batzarah (Bozrah) LaShamah (shall become an astonishment), LaCharapah (a reproach), LaCharab (a waste), WaLaQalalah (and a curse); Iyarayah (and all its cities) Iwalam (shall be perpetual) LaCharabahawath (wastes).”

Shamaithay (I have heard) Shamawaih (news) from Yahawah, WaTzayar (and an ambassador) Shalawach (is sent) BaGawayam (among the nations), saying, “HathaQabatzaw (Gather yourselves together), WaBawaaw (and come) against her, WaQawamaw (and rise up) LaMalachamah (to the battle).”
“For, behold, Nathanathayak (I have made you) Qatan (you small) BaGawayam (among the nations), BazahaWay (and despised) BaAdam (among men).

As for your terror, Zadawan (the pride) Labak (of your heart) YaHaNashayaa (has deceived) you, Shakanay (O you who dwell) BaChagaway (in the clefts) HaSalai (of the rock), Thapashay (who hold) Marawam (the height) Gabaih (of the hill): Qanak (though you should make your nest) ThaGabayah (as high) KaNashar (as the eagle), AYawarayadak (I will bring you down) from there,” Naam (says) Yahawah.
“Adawam (Edom) LaShamah (shall become an astonishment): everyone who passes YaShamam (by it shall be astonished), WaYaSharaq (and shall hiss) Makahawathah (at all its plagues).

KaMahapakahath (As in the overthrow) of Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah) and the neighbor cities,” of it, YaAmar (says) Yahawah, “Ayash (no man) YaYashab (shall dwell) there, Ban (neither shall any son) Adam (of man) live therein.

“Behold, YaIlah (he shall come up) KaArayah (like a lion) MaGaawan (from the pride) of the Yaradan (Jordan) Ayathan (against the strong) Nawah (habitation): ARagayaih (for I will suddenly) ARawayatzaw (make them run away him) from it; Bachawar (and whoever is chosen), APaqad (him will I appoint) over it: for who is like me? YaYaiyaday (and who will appoint me a time)? Raih (and who is the shepherd) YaImad (who will stand) LaPanayamay (before me)?”

Shamaiw (Therefore hear) Itzahath (the counsel) of Yahawah, YaYaitz (that he has taken) against Adawam (Edom); WaMachashabahawathayaw (and his purposes), YaChashab (that he has purposed) Yashabay (against the inhabitants) of Thayaman (Teman): Surely they shall drag them away, Tzaiyaray (the little) HaTzaan (ones of the flock); Nawaham (surely he shall make their habitation) YaShamayam (desolate over them).

HaAratz (The earth) Raishah (trembles) MaQawal (from at the noise) Napalam (of their fall); Tzaiqah (there is a cry), Qawalah (her the noise) YaNaShamai (which is heard) Sawap (in the Red) BaYam (In sea).

Behold, YaIlah (he shall come up) WaYaDaah (and fly) KaNashar (as the eagle), WaYaParash (and spread) Kanapayaw (out his wings) against Batzarah (Bozrah): Lab (and the heart) Gabawaray (of the mighty men) of Adawam (Edom) BaYawam (at that day) KaLab (shall be as the heart) Ayashah (of a woman) MaTzararah (in her pangs).

Of Damashaq (Damascus). “Chamath (Hamath) Bawashah (is confounded), and Arapad (Arpad); Shamaiw (for they have heard) Raih (evil) Shamawaih (news), NaMawagaw (they are melted) away: Daagah (there is sorrow) BaYam (on the sea); it can't HaShaqat (be quiet).

Damashaq (Damascus) Rapahathah (has grown feeble), HaPanahathah (she turns) LaNawas (herself to flee), and trembling HaChazayaqah (has seized) on her: Tzarah (anguish) WaChabalayam (and sorrows) Achazathah (have taken her) hold of her, KaYawaladah (as of a woman in travail).
Iyar (How is the city) Thahalah (of praise) not forsaken, Qarayahath (the city) Mashawashay (of my joy)?

Bachawarayah (Therefore her young men) YaNapalaw (shall fall) BaRachabathayah (in her streets), Ayanashay (and all the men) HaMalachamah (the of war) YaDamamaw (shall be brought to silence) BaYawam (in that day),” Naam (says) Yahawah Tzabaawath (of Armies).
“WaHaYatzathay (and I will kindle) Ash (a fire) BaChawamahath (in the wall) of Damashaq (Damascus), WaAkalah (and it shall devour) Aramawanawath (the palaces) of Banahadad (Ben Hadad).”

Of Qadar (Kedar), WaLaMamalakahawath (and of the kingdoms) of Chatzawar (Hazor), which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) Malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) YaHaNakah (struck). YaAmar (Thus says) Yahawah: “Qawamaw (Arise), Ilahaw (go up) to Qadar (Kedar), WaShadadaw (and destroy) Banay (the children) Qadam (of the east).

Ahalayam (Their tents) WaTzaanam (and their flocks) YaNashaaw (shall they take); YaNashaaw (they shall carry) Yarayaihawathayam (away for themselves their curtains), Kalayam (and all their vessels), WaGamalayam (and their camels); WaQaraaw (and they shall cry) to them, ‘Magawar (Terror) MaSabayab (from on every side)!’

The book of the genealogy of Yashawai Mashayach, the son of Dawad, the son of Abaraham.
Abaraham became the father of Yatzachaq. Yatzachaq became the father of Yaiqab. Yaiqab became the father of Yahawadah and his brothers.
Yahawadah became the father of Paratz and Zarach by Thamar. Paratz became the father of Chatzarawan. Chatzarawan became the father of Ram.
Ram became the father of Imayanadab. Imayanadab became the father of Nachashawan. Nachashawan became the father of Shalamah.
Shalamah became the father of Baiz by Rachab. Baiz became the father of Iwabad by Rawath. Iwabad became the father of Yashay.
Yashay became the father of King Dawad. Dawad became the father of Shalamah by her who had been Awarayah’s wife.
Shalamah became the father of Rachabaim. Rachabaim became the father of Abayah. Abayah became the father of Asaa.
Asaa became the father of Yahawashapat. Yahawashapat became the father of Yahawaram. Yahawaram became the father of Izayahaw.
Izayahaw became the father of Yawatham. Yawatham became the father of Achaz. Achaz became the father of Chazaqayahaw.
Chazaqayahaw became the father of Manashah. Manashah became the father of Amawan. Amawan became the father of Yaashayahaw.
Yaashayahaw became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babal.
After the exile to Babal, Jechoniah became the father of Shaalathayaal. Shaalathayaal became the father of Zarababal.
Zarababal became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Alayaqayam. Alayaqayam became the father of Azor.
Azor became the father of Tzadawaq. Tzadawaq became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
Eliud became the father of Alaizar. Alaizar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Yaiqab.
Yaiqab became the father of Yawasap, the husband of Marayam, from whom was born Yashawai, who is called Mashayach.

So all the generations from Abaraham to Dawad are fourteen generations; from Dawad to the exile to Babal fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babal to the Mashayach, fourteen generations.
Now the birth of Yashawai Mashayach was like this: After his mother, Marayam, was engaged to Yawasap, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
Yawasap, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Adanay appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Yawasap, son of Dawad, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Marayam, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Yashawai, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Adanay through the prophet, saying,
“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Imanawaal;” which is, being interpreted, “Alahayam with us.”
Yawasap arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Adanay commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Yashawai.
Now when Yashawai was born in Bayathalacham of Yahawadah in the days of King Hawaradawas, behold, wise men from the east came to Yarawashalam, saying,
“Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
When King Hawaradawas heard it, he was troubled, and all Yarawashalam with him.
Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Mashayach would be born.
They said to him, “In Bayathalacham of Yahawadah, for this is written through the prophet,
‘You Bayathalacham, land of Yahawadah, are in no way least among the princes of Yahawadah: for out of you shall come a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Yasharaal.’ ”
Then Hawaradawas secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
He sent them to Bayathalacham, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.
When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
They came into the house and saw the young child with Marayam, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
Being warned in a dream not to return to Hawaradawas, they went back to their own country another way.

Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Adanay appeared to Yawasap in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Matzarayam, and stay there until I tell you, for Hawaradawas will seek the young child to destroy him.”
He arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Matzarayam,
and was there until the death of Hawaradawas; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Adanay through the prophet, saying, “Out of Matzarayam I called my son.”

Then Hawaradawas, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the male children who were in Bayathalacham and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
Then that which was spoken by Yaramayahaw the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
“A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachal weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
But when Hawaradawas was dead, behold, an angel of the Adanay appeared in a dream to Yawasap in Matzarayam, saying,
“Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Yasharaal, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Yasharaal.
But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Yahawadah in the place of his father, Hawaradawas, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galayal,
and came and lived in a city called Natzarath; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.
In those days, Yawachanan the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Yahawadah, saying,
“Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
For this is he who was spoken of by Yashaiyahaw the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Adanay ready! Make his paths straight!”
Now Yawachanan himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
Then people from Yarawashalam, all of Yahawadah, and all the region around the Yaradan went out to him.
They were baptized by him in the Yaradan, confessing their sins.
But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abaraham for our father,’ for I tell you that Alahayam is able to raise up children to Abaraham from these stones.
“Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
Then Yashawai came from Galayal to the Yaradan to Yawachanan, to be baptized by him.
But Yawachanan would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
But Yashawai, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
Yashawai, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of Alahayam descending as a dove, and coming on him.
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
Then Yashawai was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of Alahayam, command that these stones become bread.”
But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of Alahayam’s mouth.’ ”
Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

and said to him, “If you are the Son of Alahayam, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’ ”
Yashawai said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Adanay, your Alahayam.’ ”
Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.
He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
Then Yashawai said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Adanay your Alahayam, and you shall serve him only.’ ”
Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
Now when Yashawai heard that Yawachanan was delivered up, he withdrew into Galayal.
Leaving Natzarath, he came and lived in Kaparanachawam, which is by the sea, in the region of Zabawalan and Napathalay,
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Yashaiyahaw the prophet, saying,
“The land of Zabawalan and the land of Napathalay, toward the sea, beyond the Yaradan, Galayal of the Gentiles,
the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
From that time, Yashawai began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
Walking by the sea of Galayal, he saw two brothers: Shamaiwan, who is called Kayapaa, and Anadaray, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
They immediately left their nets and followed him.
Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, Yaiqab the son of Zebedee, and Yawachanan his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
Yashawai went about in all Galayal, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

The report about him went out into all Aram. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
Great multitudes from Galayal, Decapolis, Yarawashalam, Yahawadah and from beyond the Yaradan followed him.
Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see Alahayam.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of Alahayam.
Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
“Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
“You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
“Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
“You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
“If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.
“You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
“It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
